objective: Reserve outcome-blind carriers for qualification of any later selected closed-form scalar decoder over the frozen ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC_ZOE coordinate before cubic-basis reduction or syndrome formula selection.

holdouts.name: PRIMARY
selectionBasis: 18-cell carrier at the same tractable resource scale as 6x3-k4
different gravity orientation from 6x3-k4, so frontier-role structure changes even though dimensions transpose
k=4 keeps the line family distinct from the previously used 3x7-k3 and 6x3-k3 cases

holdouts.name: BACKUP
selectionBasis: 15-cell carrier selected only from geometry and tractability
different width/height/k combination from every repaired-coordinate decoder-discovery case

seal: Do not solve, qualify, sample, or inspect W/D/L outcomes for 3x6-k4 or 5x3-k4 before a decoder formula is frozen.
Do not use either carrier to choose structural motifs, polynomial terms, gauges, coefficients, phase grades, thresholds, or syndrome definitions.
Repository provenance checks and geometry-only resource planning are allowed.
qualificationRule: After a decoder formula is frozen from the discovery corpus, test PRIMARY unchanged first. BACKUP remains sealed unless PRIMARY is affine/non-discriminating, resource-infeasible, or an independent second holdout is explicitly warranted.
interpretationGuards: A later pass establishes bounded fresh Q-V qualification only.
If the primary carrier is affine under the frozen coordinate, it remains valid transfer evidence but does not establish non-affine decoder necessity.
No Q-A/Q-F, standard-7x6, or universal theorem follows.
